```{r}
# ---- 0. Install / load packages ----
pkg_needed <- c("caret", "rpart", "rattle")
for (p in pkg_needed) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p)
  }
}

library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(rattle)

# ---- 1. Read and clean data ----
TitanicData <- read.csv("Titanic.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Exclude Name, Ticket, Cabin
TitanicData <- subset(TitanicData, select = -c(Name, Ticket, Cabin))

# Delete rows with missing Age
TitanicData <- TitanicData[!is.na(TitanicData$Age), ]

# Convert variables to proper types
TitanicData$Survived <- factor(TitanicData$Survived, levels = c(0, 1))
TitanicData$Pclass   <- factor(TitanicData$Pclass, levels = c(1, 2, 3))

if ("Sex" %in% names(TitanicData)) {
  TitanicData$Sex <- factor(TitanicData$Sex)
}
if ("Embarked" %in% names(TitanicData)) {
  TitanicData$Embarked <- factor(TitanicData$Embarked)
}

cat("Number of passengers left after cleaning:", nrow(TitanicData), "\n")

# 80/20 split with seed = 123
set.seed(123)
train_index <- as.vector(createDataPartition(TitanicData$Survived, p = 0.8, list = FALSE))

train.data <- TitanicData[train_index, ]
test.data  <- TitanicData[-train_index, ]

cat("Training set size:", nrow(train.data), "\n")
cat("Testing set size :", nrow(test.data), "\n")


# ---- Helper function for metrics ----
get_metrics <- function(cm_obj) {
  out <- c(
    Sensitivity = unname(cm_obj$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Specificity = unname(cm_obj$byClass["Specificity"]),
    Accuracy    = unname(cm_obj$overall["Accuracy"])
  )
  return(round(out, 4))
}


# =========================
# Problem 2
# Fully grown tree + testing performance
# =========================

# Build a fully grown tree
# cp = 0 allows splitting as much as possible
# minsplit = 2 and minbucket = 1 help grow a larger tree
full_tree <- rpart(
  Survived ~ .,
  data = train.data,
  method = "class",
  control = rpart.control(cp = 0, minsplit = 2, minbucket = 1, xval = 10)
)

# Draw the full tree using rattle
fancyRpartPlot(full_tree, main = "Full Classification Tree")

# Predict on testing data
pred_full <- predict(full_tree, newdata = test.data, type = "class")
pred_full <- factor(pred_full, levels = levels(test.data$Survived))

# Confusion matrix
cm_full <- confusionMatrix(
  data = pred_full,
  reference = test.data$Survived,
  positive = "1"
)

cat("\n===== Problem 2: Full Tree Confusion Matrix =====\n")
print(cm_full)

cat("\n===== Problem 2: Full Tree Metrics =====\n")
print(get_metrics(cm_full))


# =========================
# Problem 3
# Prune the full tree using 10-fold CV
# =========================

cat("\n===== Problem 3: Complexity Table =====\n")
printcp(full_tree)

# Complexity plot
plotcp(full_tree, main = "Complexity Plot for Full Tree")

# Best CP = CP corresponding to minimum xerror
best_cp_row <- which.min(full_tree$cptable[, "xerror"])
best_cp <- full_tree$cptable[best_cp_row, "CP"]

cat("\nBest CP value:", best_cp, "\n")

# Prune the tree
pruned_tree <- prune(full_tree, cp = best_cp)

# Draw pruned tree using rattle
fancyRpartPlot(pruned_tree, main = "Optimal Pruned Tree")


# =========================
# Problem 4
# Testing performance of pruned tree
# =========================

pred_pruned <- predict(pruned_tree, newdata = test.data, type = "class")
pred_pruned <- factor(pred_pruned, levels = levels(test.data$Survived))

cm_pruned <- confusionMatrix(
  data = pred_pruned,
  reference = test.data$Survived,
  positive = "1"
)

cat("\n===== Problem 4: Pruned Tree Confusion Matrix =====\n")
print(cm_pruned)

cat("\n===== Problem 4: Pruned Tree Metrics =====\n")
print(get_metrics(cm_pruned))


# =========================
# Problem 5
# Output test data + both predictions + agreement table
# =========================

test_output <- test.data
test_output$FullTree_Prediction   <- pred_full
test_output$PrunedTree_Prediction <- pred_pruned

cat("\n===== Problem 5: Test Data with Predictions =====\n")
print(test_output)

agreement_table <- table(
  FullTree   = test_output$FullTree_Prediction,
  PrunedTree = test_output$PrunedTree_Prediction
)

cat("\n===== Problem 5: Agreement Table =====\n")
print(agreement_table)

# Optional: save the output
# write.csv(test_output, "Titanic_test_with_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
